steps.title: Prepare Concentrated TRAP Isolation Buffer (CTIB)
steps.instruction: Make CTIB fresh for the total volume needed by mixing the listed reagents in the order given, then keep the buffer on ice (4 °C) and use within 8 h.

substeps.instruction: Add 10 µl 1 M HEPES, pH 7.5 (Fisher Scientific, cat. NC1584170).
Add 117 µl 1 M MgCl₂, molecular biology grade (Fisher Scientific, cat. AM9530G).
Add 333 µl 3 M KCl, molecular biology grade (Alfa Aesar, cat. J64189, lot X18D048).
Add 100 µl 100 % IGEPAL (Sigma‑Aldrich, cat. I3021‑100ML).
Add 1 µl 100 µg/µl cycloheximide, 98 % (Fisher Scientific, cat. NC9651091).
Add 275 µl 40 mg/ml sodium heparin (CAS 9041‑08‑1; Fisher Scientific, cat. BP2425).
Add 20 µl 1 M DTT, molecular biology grade (Sigma‑Aldrich, cat. D9779‑1G).
Add 110 µl 20 U/µl RNase inhibitor (Fisher Scientific, cat. N8080119).
Add 20 µl 50× complete EDTA‑free protease inhibitor (Sigma‑Aldrich, cat. 11873580001; 1 tablet dissolved in 1 ml HyPure Water, GE Life Sciences, cat. SH30538.03).
Add 14 µl HyPure Water, Molecular Biology Grade (GE Life Sciences, cat. SH30538.03).

Mix well; final concentrations are 10 mM HEPES pH 7.5, 117 mM MgCl₂, 1 M KCl, 10 % IGEPAL CA‑630, 100 µg/ml cycloheximide, 11 mg/ml sodium heparin, 20 mM DTT, 2.2 U/µl RNase inhibitor, 1× protease inhibitor.
Store on ice (4 °C) and use within 8 h.

steps.title: Prepare RNase Inhibitor Mix (optional)
steps.instruction: If desired, substitute the RNase inhibitor portion of CTIB with a mix of RNase inhibitor and SUPERase Inhibitor prepared fresh.

substeps.instruction: Combine 10 µl 20 U/µl RNase inhibitor (Fisher Scientific, cat. N8080119) with 10 µl SUPERase Inhibitor (Fisher Scientific, cat. AM2694).
Add 90 µl HyPure Water, Molecular Biology Grade (GE Life Sciences, cat. SH30538.03) to bring the volume to 110 µl.
Use this mixture in place of the 110 µl RNase inhibitor portion of the CTIB recipe.

steps.title: Prepare Nuclear Preparation Buffer (NPB)
steps.instruction: Make NPB fresh; store the bulk buffer at 4 °C for up to 1 week, then add DTT and cycloheximide immediately before use and keep on ice for ≤8 h.

substeps.instruction: Combine 500 µl 1 M HEPES, pH 7.5 (Fisher Scientific, cat. NC1584170).
Add 75 µl 1 M MgCl₂ (Fisher Scientific, cat. AM9530G or Alfa Aesar, cat. J64189, lot X18D048).
Add 167 µl 3 M KCl (Alfa Aesar, cat. J64189, lot X18D048).
Add 4.275 g sucrose (Sigma‑Aldrich, cat. S1888‑500).
Add 500 µl 10 % IGEPAL (Sigma‑Aldrich, cat. I3021‑100ML).
Add 1 ml 50× complete EDTA‑free protease inhibitor (Sigma‑Aldrich, cat. 11873580001; 1 tablet dissolved in 1 ml HyPure Water, GE Life Sciences, cat. SH30538.03).
Bring the volume to 49.8 ml with HyPure Water, Molecular Biology Grade (GE Life Sciences, cat. SH30538.03).
Store the resulting buffer at 4 °C; it is stable for up to 1 week.
Right before use, add 0.2 µl 1 M DTT (Sigma‑Aldrich, cat. D9779‑1G) per 1 ml NPB.
Add 1 µl 100 µg/µl cycloheximide, 98 % (Fisher Scientific, cat. NC9651091) per 1 ml NPB.
Mix and keep on ice (4 °C); use within 8 h.
Final concentrations after addition are 10 mM HEPES pH 7.5, 1.5 mM MgCl₂, 10 mM KCl, 250 mM sucrose, 0.1 % IGEPAL CA‑630, 0.2 mM DTT, 100 µg/ml cycloheximide.

steps.title: Lyse P42 mouse hippocampus in NPB
steps.instruction: For each bilateral P42 mouse hippocampus, add 1 ml of freshly prepared NPB, keep the tissue on ice, and homogenize quickly to lyse cell membranes while preserving nuclear integrity.
